query/name: Gaia DR3: every well-measured source within 100 light years (CSV)
query/params: {"REQUEST":"doQuery","LANG":"ADQL","FORMAT":"csv","QUERY":"SELECT designation, l, b, parallax, parallax_error, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp, radial_velocity FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE parallax > 32.6157 AND parallax_over_error > 10"}
